scope: Git metadata only: no code audit, secrets inspection, deletion, prune, branch removal, PR closure, push, or merge.

classification_definitions.active_S1: S1 source retained for active B1 reconciliation.
classification_definitions.future_S2S3_preserved: Later operational-sprint source preserved without execution.
classification_definitions.approved_to_integrate: Exact approved packet retained for B1 composition.
classification_definitions.substituted_proven: Source is represented by documented destination commits.
classification_definitions.outside_campaign: Reachable from origin/main but outside current bundle action.
classification_definitions.origin_destination_to_resolve: No disposal inference; root must select a bundle or explicit destination.
